caption: The drawing shows a geometric shape resembling a wide hexagon, divided into six sections, each containing a different textile or pattern design. The upper left section has a black background filled with brown, yellow, and beige floral shapes. The upper center section features a cream background with vertical rows of stylized plant motifs in black and a repeating red flower. The upper right section has an irregular, wavy pattern composed of black and brown shapes, highlighted by clusters of white dots. The lower left section displays a bright pattern with a dark background, overlaid with green, white, pink, and purple paisley-like forms and small flower shapes. The lower center section has a cream base with thin, parallel brown lines forming symmetrical feather or leaf-like vertical arrangements. The lower right section consists of a blue background with a grid texture, decorated with repetitive yellow leaf motif clusters. The entire composition is set against a plain beige background. There is a signature "White" in the bottom right corner.
